decision_rationale: M1-U accurately predicts regime deterioration and hazard transitions (AUC ~0.78), but applying frozen health states as early position-exit rules degrades realized trading economics across all variants (P1, P2, P3) compared to the natural V_A regime-flip baseline (P0) due to severe truncation of re-extending trend winners.
reversal_rationale: Persistent Q4 invalidation leads natural regime flip by an average of 178.4 seconds with 0.81 ATR prospective adverse price excursion, indicating strong information for prospective opposite-direction entry rather than position exit.
